title: Client call safety: idempotency conventions, hedged requests, and unified backoff
creator: Asha Patel
description: Scope: Define and implement a single, language-agnostic client call-safety spec for Redwood SDKs that covers idempotency token format, server-side deduplication expectations, hedged requests semantics, and a unified retry/timeout/backoff configuration surface. The goal is to reduce accidental double-execution risk during multi-region failover and to let platform routing and the runtime make safe hedging decisions without leaking responsibility onto every product service. This ticket covers spec authoring, SDK surface changes (JS/Python/Go), server acceptance tests, and a canary rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: A concise spec (<=2 pages) published to Confluence with examples for 3 SDKs: JS, Python, Go
SDK changes implemented for createIdempotencyToken(), hedgedCall(config) and a single RetryConfig structure; API docs for each SDK updated
Server-side dedupe library accepts the recommended token format and returns a clear dedupe status code when a duplicate is detected
Integration tests that simulate multi-region failover and hedged duplicate arrival pass in CI (latency/duplicate metrics asserted)
Canary rollout plan and rollback criteria documented; initial canary shows no customer-facing errors in 24h and <0.1% increased duplicate operations
comments: 2026-02-12 Asha: Kickoff - scoped ticket after postmortem for INC-2026-03-01-42. Goal is to stop expensive double-executions when regional leaders fail and SDKs retry aggressively.

2026-02-18 Marco: Drafted idempotency token proposal - 3 parts: clientNonce (128-bit), routeFingerprint, optional operationTTL. Posted to design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Client+Call+Safety+Spec
2026-02-21 Eng sync: Decided hedged requests will be opt-in per-call and opt-out at SDK-level. Runtime will expose an advisory latency percentile endpoint for heuristic hedging decisions.
2026-02-28 QA: Added integration test plan to reproduce simultaneous hedged deliveries + server dedupe race. Test harness PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7892
2026-03-03 Security review stubbed in; confirmed token entropy meets replay-resistance requirements. No encryption-at-rest changes required for dedupe index.

2026-03-05 Load test: synthetic workloads (10k rps across two regions) show hedging at 5% increases duplicates by 0.06% and reduces p99 tail by 22%. Results: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/hedging/loadtest-20260305
2026-03-08 PR feedback: API ergonomics meet JS/Go teams' expectations; Python team asked for helper context-manager for hedged calls. Added follow-up subtask.
2026-03-10 Marco: Marked core SDKs ready for internal alpha. Preparing canary playbook with SREs. Linked runtime feature flag: runtime/feature/hedged-safe-v1
incident_reference: INC-2026-03-01-42 - multi-region failover during us-east outage caused duplicate state changes in customer workflows due to client-side retry semantics
observability: Add dedupe_rate (per-API-key, per-route) to Console UI and alert if >0.5% sustained over 1h
Expose hedged_request_rate and hedged_success_latency improvement per-region
Dashboard: runtime-1.22/hedging-canary showing p50/p95/p99 before/after and duplicate ratios
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Hedging increases duplicates and could surface to customers as duplicate downstream state changes. Mitigation: default hedging off; require opt-in and server-side dedupe acknowledgement codes; provide best-effort client helpers for idempotent operation design.
Risk: Token collision or replay. Mitigation: 128-bit nonce + route fingerprint + TTL; servers maintain short lived dedupe index and reject replays beyond TTL.
Risk: SDK divergence across languages. Mitigation: publish canonical spec and run cross-language conformance suite in CI before release.

Merge SDK PRs with feature-flag gating and enable internal alpha (owner: Marco) by 2026-03-15
Coordinate canary with SRE: run 48h canary in us-west2 with traffic ramp to 5% and monitor dedupe_rate and error budgets
Add server acceptance tests for dedupe codes and hedged delivery ordering (owner: platform team)
